clips.title: The story
paras: In northern Tirisfal, the Agamand Family Dagger rests among the weapons in the family crypt. Coleman Farthing seeks it and the family’s other arms to strip his former masters of their legacy and honor.

Before the Third War, the Agamand family held vast estates and grain mills in the rolling meadows of northern Tirisfal Glades. The Scourge destroyed their power, but their weapons endured in the family crypt north of Agamand Mills. Restless undead members of the household and mindless servants of the Lich King guard the dagger. It recalls the martial heritage and standing the family once held above its servants and tenants.

Coleman Farthing resides at Brill, but he once died in the Agamands’ service. He blames the family for his death, and the dagger means resentment to him, not noble lineage. Farthing sends adventurers into the Agamand Family Crypt for the dagger, sword, axe, and mace. By taking these arms from the tomb, he seeks to rob the Scourge patriarchs of their last dignity and extinguish the Agamand name.
